context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/tests/iter139_leaderboard_look.py as the regression entry. Sign-in requires a ~700ms wait between PinField fill and continue-button click, else the click lands before the form is 'ready' and the request never fires. Install fake_aits BEFORE fake_board. For colour checks, descend from the testID root and collect getComputedStyle(el).backgroundImage containing 'gradient' - the first is the running edge, the second is the face. Animation names return React-Reanimated-style tokens like 'REA-CSS-N'; check len >= 2 rather than exact names. My Tests tab testIDs are 'my-tests-tab-done' | 'my-tests-tab-progress' | 'my-tests-tab-saved' (NOT 'tests-tab-*' or 'tab-tests-*').
